capabilities: Sync the whole vault across devices through a Dropbox App Folder
Merge concurrent text edits line by line against the last synced version
Resolve conflict blocks and keep conflict copies for unmergeable files
Pause and preview syncs that would delete many files
Optionally sync settings, themes, snippets and plugins
extras: Not in the Obsidian community plugin list and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed manually from GitHub releases. The plugin's network requests go only to Dropbox, and plugin settings from other plugins may contain secrets if configuration sync is enabled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync across devices through the user's own cloud storage account.
summary: Syncs one person's vault across desktop and mobile devices through a cloud storage service, currently Dropbox, with text merge and conflict handling.
